name: mutinybim
description: MutinyBIM agent tools as packs: connect the core plus only the packs a job needs (drafting, ducts and pipes, electrical, plumbing, views and sheets, coordination, groups and phases, parts, calculations, schedules). Each pack is one MCP server and one Agent Skill of the same name.

packs.label: MutinyBIM core
packs.purpose: Write, check, preview and land scripts that read and change the model, save a part script's parts, and four reads to look before writing

packs.label: Model reads and everyday edits
packs.purpose: Schedule rows, levels, views and sheets, linked models, surfaces; previews and the everyday part edits; pictures, printing and issuing sheets; coordination lint

packs.label: Drafting and annotation
packs.purpose: Dimensions, tags, notes with leaders, detail linework and detail components

packs.label: Duct and pipe runs
packs.purpose: Route, connect, resize, slope, insulate and fit duct and pipe runs

packs.label: Electrical circuits and diagrams
packs.purpose: Panels, circuits, feeders, receptacle proposals, one-line and riser diagrams

packs.label: Plumbing loads and design
packs.purpose: Fixture load points, connection types, pipe types and each pipe system's sizing

packs.label: Views and sheets
packs.purpose: Views, crops, 3D views, sheets, viewports, sheet notes and layout

packs.label: Coordination and linked models
packs.purpose: Linked models, levels from them, coordinates, accepted findings and rooms

packs.label: Groups, phases and typed elements
packs.purpose: Groups, locks, phases, phase filters and typed element values

packs.label: Part definitions
packs.purpose: Draft, check and save parts, the firm's part library, clearances and hosts

packs.label: Calculations
packs.purpose: Code calculations, duct size advice, duct pressure and pipe hydraulics reports, pipe sizing and service size

packs.label: Schedules
packs.purpose: Define schedules, edit their cells and manage the schedule library
